stories.title: Auto-login after venue signup
stories.acceptance_criteria: After venue create (non-founder): client calls auth.login with form credentials, redirects to dashboard. User lands in app logged in. No redirect to verify-email-pending.

stories.title: Resend verification from manager dashboard
stories.acceptance_criteria: Unverified banner has 'Resend verification email' button. Click calls resend API. Shows success or error message.

stories.title: Resend endpoint: session or body
stories.acceptance_criteria: POST /resend-verification: if authenticated, use session venue_id (no body). If unauthenticated, require venueId in body. Both paths work.

stories.title: Rate limit feedback on resend
stories.acceptance_criteria: When resend hits 5/hour limit: return 429 with retryAfterMinutes. Client shows 'Try again in X minutes'.

stories.title: Email send diagnostics and logging
stories.acceptance_criteria: SMTP fail: log verification_email_failed with reason. SMTP not configured: log link at INFO. Consider APP_BASE_URL validation on startup.

stories.title: VerifyPendingPage improvements
stories.acceptance_criteria: Add 'Already have an account? Log in' link. Resend works with venueId in body for unauthenticated users.

stories.title: Troubleshooting documentation
stories.acceptance_criteria: docs/email-verification-troubleshooting.md: SMTP not configured, APP_BASE_URL, rate limit, token expired, spam. README link.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: npm run build. Full flow: signup → auto-login → dashboard → resend from banner → verify → manager enabled.
